appNotDetectedTip: Save and manage your Safari tabs with Tab Space.
extensionPermissionHint: Click the Tab Space extension button in Safari and choose “Always Allow on Every Website”; otherwise, Tab Space cannot access your tabs.
noSessionsTip: Click the Tab Space icon in the Safari toolbar to save all open tabs as one session.
ignore-pinned-tabs: Ignore pinned web pages while saving tabs
ignore-duplicated-tabs: Don't save duplicated tabs (even for those in different sessions)
remove-site-after-click: Remove saved tab from the session when you click it
shortcutTip: Note: shortcuts do not work when Safari address bar is empty.
appIntroduction: Born for improving your web browsing productivity.
upgradeSafari:

 Please upgrade your Safari.
restoreConfirm: Restore sessions from backup? Duplicates will be skipped.
backupInfoAuto: Backups are created automatically when you save sessions (max every 5 min).
backupInfoRetention: Retention: 7 hourly, 7 daily, 4 weekly, 12 monthly backups.
updateReady: A new version of the dashboard is ready.
mergeIncludesTags: Session tags will also be merged.
iosBannerText: Now on iPhone & iPad with iCloud sync
iosBannerScanHint: Scan with your iPhone camera to install
splitOriginalToTrash: The original session moves to Trash — you can restore it anytime.
featureEnhanceDesc: AI names and tags your sessions as you save.
featureSplitDesc: Break a big session into clean, topic-based sessions.
featureBatchDesc: Apply a whole type of suggestion across your library at once.
featureUnlimitedDesc: Use AI as much as you like — no weekly limit.
featureMultiBrowserDesc: Use the same sessions in Safari, Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Firefox.
continueInApp: Continuing in the Tab Space app…
subscriptionManagedInApp: Plans and payment are handled securely in the Tab Space app.
subscriptionActivated: Your subscription is active. AI is ready to use.
subscriptionActivationPending: Subscribed in the Tab Space app? Refresh the dashboard to start using it.
freeTierInfo: Free plan: a weekly allowance of AI requests.
suggestionReportEmpty: No suggestions right now. Your library looks tidy!
suggestionExactDuplicateDesc: These {count} sessions contain the same tabs and can be merged.
suggestionNearDuplicateDesc: These sessions share most of their tabs — merge them?
suggestionOversizedDesc: This session has {count} tabs. Split it into topics?
suggestionOrphanTagsDesc: The tag "{tag}" is used only once.
aiErrorGeneric: AI request failed. Please try again.
aiErrorNetwork: Network problem. Check your connection and try again.
aiErrorUnauthorized: Please open the Tab Space app to sign in again.
splitNoTopics: This session is already focused on one topic.
aiErrorTooMany: This session has too many tabs for AI. Sessions over {limit} tabs can't be processed.
aiErrorTooManyNoLimit: This session is too large for AI. Split it into smaller sessions first.
suggestedTagsHint: Comma-separated tags the AI will prefer to use
plusOwnedSummary: Unlimited sessions and all core features are yours permanently. You also receive 5 AI requests each week; Pro makes AI unlimited.
freeSessionAllowanceUsed: Session saved. Your Free session allowance is now used; upgrade to save another.
proOnlyInfo: Free and Plus include 5 AI requests each week. Pro removes the weekly limit.
multiBrowserStep1: Open Tab Space on your Mac, choose Multi-Browser Support, then Show Pairing Code.
multiBrowserStep2: Install the Tab Space extension in Chrome, Microsoft Edge, or Firefox 121 or later.
multiBrowserStep3: Enter the six-digit code in the extension to connect it.
multiBrowserConnected: This browser is connected to Tab Space.
multiBrowserProNote: Multi-browser support is included with Pro.
aiAutoEnhanceDescription: After you save tabs, AI names the session and adds tags automatically. Only page titles and URLs are sent.
aiConsentLede: AI features send some information about your tabs off your device. Here is exactly what happens.
aiConsentSentDetail: Only the page titles and URLs of the tabs in that session. Never page contents, cookies, form data, or anything from other tabs.
aiConsentRecipientsDetail: The Tab Space AI service, hosted on Cloudflare, which forwards the titles and URLs to Google Gemini to generate the result. Tab Space does not store them and does not use them to train models.
aiConsentQuotaDetail: Free and Plus include 5 AI requests each week. Each AI action uses one. Pro removes the weekly limit.
aiConsentRevokeNote: You can turn AI off again at any time in Settings. Nothing is sent while it is off.
whatsNewLede: Version {version} adds a browser tab switcher: one shortcut reaches any tab, whether it is still open or saved away.
whatsNewSwitcherDetail: Search every tab you have open from any app on your Mac, then jump straight to it.
whatsNewSavedTitle: Your saved tabs are in there too
whatsNewSavedDetail: A tab you closed weeks ago is as easy to reach as one that is still open. Included on every plan.
whatsNewBrowsersTitle: Chrome, Edge, and Firefox with Pro
whatsNewBrowsersDetail: Safari tabs come with every plan. Pro adds the tabs open in Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Firefox.
switcherActivationChip: open Tab Space to finish setup
switcherActivationBody: After updating, open Tab Space once to enable {shortcut} and the menu bar switcher.
switcherIntro: Press {shortcut} anywhere on your Mac to search every tab you have open and every tab you have ever saved, then jump straight to it.
switcherPlans: Safari tabs and your saved sessions are included on every plan. Tabs from Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Firefox need Pro.
switcherSettingsNote: Change the shortcut or hide the menu bar icon in Tab Space settings.
